description: In April 2026, Senator Chris Coons was one of only seven Senate Democrats who crossed party lines to keep $446.8 million in U.S. weapons — 12,000 1,000-pound bombs and Caterpillar D9 military bulldozers — flowing to Israel. This is why that vote matters, and why Delaware deserves better.
